cards.card_text: His attendants propose a plan: commissioners in every province gather beautiful young women into the harem at the citadel of Susa.
cards.verse_text: Then the king’s attendants proposed, “Let a search be made for beautiful young virgins for the king, and let the king appoint commissioners in each province of his kingdom to assemble all the beautiful young women into the harem at the citadel of Susa.
cards.snippet: …of his kingdom to assemble all the beautiful young women into the harem at the citadel of Susa.

cards.card_text: Hegai also gives Esther seven select maidservants and moves her to the ___ place in the harem.
cards.verse_text: He assigned to her seven select maidservants from the palace and transferred her with them to the best place in the harem.
cards.snippet: …palace and transferred her with them to the best place in the harem.

cards.card_text: Esther is inside the harem now, and Mordecai is on the outside.
cards.verse_text: And every day Mordecai would walk back and forth in front of the court of the harem to learn about Esther’s welfare and what was happening to her.
cards.snippet: …would walk back and forth in front of the court of the harem to learn about Esther’s welfare and what was happening to her.

cards.card_text: When a young woman's turn comes to go to the king, what can she take with her from the harem?
cards.verse_text: When the young woman would go to the king, she was given whatever she requested to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.
cards.snippet: …she was given whatever she requested to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.

cards.card_text: In the morning she goes to a second harem, under Shaashgaz, the king's eunuch in charge of the concubines.
cards.verse_text: She would go there in the evening, and in the morning she would return to a second harem under the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch in charge of the concubines.
